_about: Measures the Factory must record to run the rules, calibrate the simulation twin and judge experiments X1-X14. Definitions follow the value-stream model (probes/value-stream/vs_sim.py) so live and simulated figures are comparable. Thresholds are not set here: they are set in AR-08 (standards) and AR-12 (monitoring and improvement plan).

measures.name: Clean ideas per week
measures.definition: Ideas that reached live in the week with full intent delivered and no escaped defect found within 7 days of deploy [PROPOSED: the model's incidents follow a deploy by 24 h on average (INCIDENT_DELAY_H), so 7 days covers over 99.9% of them].

measures.name: Ideas live per week
measures.definition: Ideas deployed to production in the week, clean or not.

measures.name: Change-failure rate
measures.definition: Share of production deploys that cause an incident, rollback or hotfix.

measures.name: Lead time, median and 90th percentile
measures.definition: Hours from idea intake to live, per idea.

measures.name: Cost per clean idea
measures.definition: All model spend in the period divided by M01 for the period.

measures.name: Cost from idea to artifact
measures.definition: Baseline at intake from the pack's cost model; actual = metered model spend plus the actual costs the Owner enters (vendor invoices, subscriptions, cloud credits including development sessions) plus recorded human hours, from idea intake to the first artifact: merged code or a ratified document. An idea is worth nothing without action; this is what it cost to turn it into something.
measures.unit: USD and human hours per idea

measures.name: Realised value from ratification to return
measures.definition: Baseline at intake: the expected return stated in the idea's Alignment Record. Actual: timestamps for ratification, production and first monetisation or other real-world return, with the value the Owner records. An idea with no action is recorded as 'no action' with value zero.

measures.name: Token use per invocation
measures.definition: Per model invocation: time to first token (latency), generation time, tool and wait time, input, cached-input and output tokens, list-price cost and throttle events, keyed to idea, card, step and model version. Latency is waiting and is not billed, but it counts in elapsed time.
measures.sim_field: CARD_TOKENS, STEP_TOKENS, GEN_DUTY, IN_PER_OUT, CACHE_HIT, TTFT_S, CALLS_PER_H

measures.name: Pass rate per model, step and tier
measures.definition: Share of attempts accepted by the next institution, per model version, value-stream step and card tier.

measures.name: Markdown rate per institution and tier
measures.definition: Share of an institution's outputs marked down by the next institution, per tier, with R8 reason codes.

measures.name: Coupling
measures.definition: Share of ordered requirement pairs within an idea where one depends on the other.

measures.name: Stale rebuilds per idea
measures.definition: Cards rebuilt because a prerequisite they read changed after they were built.

measures.name: All-family miss share
measures.definition: Share of escaped defects that every model family which checked the artifact missed.

measures.name: Step hours and queue waits
measures.definition: Busy hours and waiting hours per value-stream step, per card and per idea.

measures.name: Defect catch by check
measures.definition: For each defect: where it was injected, which check caught it (unit test, CI, review, security review, audit, QA, release, smoke, live) and which checks passed it.

measures.name: Burn rate
measures.definition: Model spend per hour on running instances, and its trailing seven-day average.

measures.name: Human attention
measures.definition: Isa's hours per week on ratification, standards, amendments, Release Gate governance changes and R13 escalations.

measures.name: Demand profile
measures.definition: Ideas arriving per week, requirements per idea, cards per requirement and card size by tier.

measures.name: Interface error cost against packet rework
measures.definition: Rework caused by interface faults between requirements, compared with rework when several requirements go in one invocation.

measures.name: Waivers
measures.definition: Every R13 or R18 waiver: which rule was relaxed, for which card, and why.

measures.name: Hand-backs and rounds per card
measures.definition: At every institutional boundary: cards handed back as not fit for purpose (R21), with the reason and the producing institution; and the number of rounds each card makes through the pipeline before it is accepted, including amendments found late.
measures.unit: counts per card and per idea

measures.name: Human turnaround and send-backs
measures.definition: For every item routed to Isa: time from request to decision, and whether it was sent back for another round. Counted in lead time like any institution's work.

measures.name: Quality, cost and speed per model and step
measures.definition: Per model version and value-stream step: pass rate (quality), cost per accepted output (cost) and elapsed hours per accepted output, latency included (speed). The inputs to R14's price.
